input.quote: The Company shall have exclusive artistic and editorial control over the Site, including, without limitation, the implementation of the Content on the Site and the design and look and feel of the Site.
input.rationale: The Agreement contains no intellectual property ownership provision at all. HDI designs, develops, hosts and operates the Site and receives all of our Content, customer and order data, but nothing allocates ownership of the Site, code, look and feel, domain name or the data we supply; Section 5.2 gives us only artistic and editorial control, and the only IP grant in the document runs the other way (our \"Deerskin\" Marks licensed to HDI in Section 6.1). With no clause on ownership, assignment, licence-back or use of our data, the rule fails at both preferred and fallback level. We propose a single new Section 5.5 at the preferred position: we own the deliverables and work product created for us with HDI assigning them, HDI keeps its pre-existing IP subject to a perpetual, irrevocable, royalty-free licence to any embedded HDI IP, we retain all rights in our Content and data with HDI's licence limited to processing it solely to provide the Services, and no joint ownership. If HDI resists the assignment, the fallback (HDI retains generic tools and know-how against a perpetual, irrevocable, worldwide, royalty-free licence to use, modify and sublicense the deliverables) is acceptable.

proposal.summary: Insert a new Section 5.5 (Ownership) allocating ownership of the Site deliverables and Company data.
proposal.comment: [Playbook] The Agreement is silent on ownership of the Site, work product and our Content and customer data, so we have added a short ownership section: we own the deliverables created for us (with HDI assigning them), HDI keeps its pre-existing IP subject to a perpetual, irrevocable, royalty-free licence to anything embedded, we retain all rights in our data with HDI's use limited to processing it solely to provide the Services, and nothing is jointly owned.

ops.text: Ownership. The Company owns all deliverables and work product created for the Company under this Agreement, including the Site, the Content and the design and look and feel of the Site, and HDI hereby assigns all such deliverables and work product to the Company. HDI retains its pre-existing intellectual property and grants the Company a perpetual, irrevocable, royalty-free license to any HDI intellectual property embedded in such deliverables. The Company retains all rights in the Content and in all customer, order, user and other data belonging to, supplied by or processed for the Company, and any license of such data to HDI is limited to processing it solely to provide the Services. No intellectual property shall be jointly owned by the Parties.
